summary: Describes the changes to OSPF needed to support IPv6. The fundamental mechanisms, including flooding, designated router election, areas, and SPF calculations, stay the same. Changes were needed because of differences in protocol semantics between IPv4 and IPv6 and to handle the larger addresses. It replaced RFC 2740 and has been updated several times.

eli5.summary: This is the routing system for the newer, longer internet addresses. It works like the older version, with small changes to fit the longer addresses.
